stem: Jamal wrote the inequality \( \frac{x}{16} \leq 6 \). Which situation is best represented by this inequality?

options.label: A
options.text: Jamal divided x pieces of paper among 16 students, and each student received fewer than 6 pieces of paper.

options.label: B
options.text: Jamal placed x cards in 16 stacks, and there were no more than 6 cards in each stack.

options.label: C
options.text: Jamal separated x shirts into 6 stacks, and each stack had at least 16 shirts.

options.label: D
options.text: Jamal shared 16 markers with x classmates, and each classmate had fewer than 6 markers.
